name: 4-Br-DMT
summary: 4-Bromo-DMT, or 4-Br-DMT, also known as 4-bromo-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a non-selective serotonin receptor modulator and serotonin releasing agent of the tryptamine family related to serotonergic psychedelics like psilocin (4-HO-DMT) and 5-bromo-DMT.

pharmacology.text: 4-Bromo-DMT shows high affinity for a variety of serotonin receptors, including the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, 5-HT2C, 5-HT6, and 5-HT7 receptors (Ki = 3.5–82 nM). The drug shows higher affinity for almost all of these receptors than psilocin or dimethyltryptamine (DMT). Its potential agonistic and antagonistic activities at serotonin receptors including the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor were not assessed.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin releasing agent; Psychoactive drug
